# goslop text fixture
lang: python
file: CWE-89-sqlalchemy-text-safe.py
---
from sqlalchemy import text


def update_tier(db, tier, score, now, story_id):
    db.execute(
        text(
            "UPDATE stories SET verification_tier = :tier, "
            "verification_score = :score, updated_at = :now "
            "WHERE id = :id"
        ),
        {"tier": tier, "score": score, "now": now, "id": story_id},
    )
